verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗ ਹੁਇ ਧਾਵਤ ਬਰਜਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਬਾਸੁ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh maarag hui dhaavat baraj raakhai sahaj bisraam dhaam nihachal baas hai ||

en.bdb: A Guru-conscious person is able to arrest the wandering of the mind by following the teachings of the Guru. He is thus able to live in stable, peaceful and equipoise state.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਰਜ ਰੂਪ ਕੈ ਅਨੂਪ ਊਪ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮ ਦਰਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan saran raj roop kai anoop uoop dharas dharas sam dharas pragaas hai ||

en.bdb: Coming into the refuge of the True Guru and feeling the holy dust of the True Guru's feet, a Guru-conscious person becomes beautiful of radiance. Beholding a glimpse of the True Guru, he is enlightened with the rare quality of treating all living beings alike.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਕੋ ਬਿਸਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv bajar kapaaT khule anahadh naadh bisamaadh ko bisavaas hai ||

en.bdb: By the union of Guru's teachings with consciousness and achieving absorption in Naam, his ego and arrogance of self-assertion is destroyed. Hearing the sweet tune of Naam Simran, he experiences an astonishing state.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ਅਲੇਖ ਲੇਖ ਕੈ ਅਲੇਖ ਭਏ ਪਰਦਛਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੁਖ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੨੫੯॥
verses.translit_en: a(n)mirat baanee alekh lekh kai alekh bhe paradhachhanaa kai sukh dhaasan ke dhaas hai ||259||

en.bdb: By imbibing the unreachable teachings of the Guru in mind, a Guru-conscious person is freed from rendering account of his life before God. By the circumambulation of the True Guru, he achieves spiritual comfort. Living in humility, he serves as servant of the servants of the True Guru. (259)
